correctness.rationale: The transfer relation L_m f=f/m gives the exact product-slope lag covariances; the two-by-two inverse gives the closed variance and the numerator derivative identity (d-e)^2, with positive denominator. BV-contraction plus environmental mixing establishes ergodicity; a bounded reverse Poisson solution gives the functional martingale CLT. At t=1 a frozen label yields the exact Gaussian mixture. The 159 finite rational checks independently corroborate the algebra, but not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is an exact and sharp dynamical response law for stationary random expanding maps: at fixed one-time slope frequencies and fixed invariant positional distribution, environmental persistence alone strictly controls long-run fluctuations. The Gaussian-to-non-Gaussian frozen-environment transition with continuous variance exposes a meaningful sharp ergodicity boundary not measured by stationary density or generic CLT theory.
